findings.source_passage: Conduct may be founded on the hard rock or the wet marshes, but after a certain point I don't care what it's founded on.
findings.source_locator: paragraph 5, opening of 'admission that it has a limit'
findings.why_it_matters: This is a voice-establishing sentence — Nick's characteristic hedged-then-cut-off moral formulation. Its removal flattens the transition between tolerance and judgment that the whole novel depends on.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the 'hard rock or the wet marshes' sentence; it's short and carries interpretive weight for Nick's unreliability.

findings.source_passage: frequently I have feigned sleep, preoccupation, or a hostile levity when I realized by some unmistakable sign that an intimate revelation was quivering on the horizon
findings.why_it_matters: This is signature Nick-voice — the ironic, self-incriminating catalogue that establishes his snobbery-as-confession. The draft's shortcut ('Most of the confidences were unsought; the intimate revelations...') erases the comic specificity.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the 'feigned sleep, preoccupation, or a hostile levity... quivering on the horizon' clause.

findings.source_passage: Almost any exhibition of complete self-sufficiency draws a stunned tribute from me.
findings.source_locator: after Miss Baker's first nod, before 'I looked back at my cousin'
findings.why_it_matters: A signature Nick aphorism establishing his posture toward Jordan and his characteristic ironic self-report.
findings.suggested_fix: Reinstate the sentence; it is short and voice-defining.

findings.source_passage: "We've got to beat them down," whispered Daisy, winking ferociously toward the fervent sun.
findings.why_it_matters: Daisy's sardonic whisper is key to reading her performed cynicism and her complicity/distance regarding Tom's racism — it reverberates with 'Sophisticated — God, I'm sophisticated!'
findings.suggested_fix: Restore Daisy's whispered line and the 'fervent sun' image.

summary: Major signatures (opening, 'beautiful little fool,' 'romantic readiness,' green light, anchored balloon, 'Sophisticated') are preserved verbatim; several medium/low voice-flattening losses in Nick's ironic asides and one Daisy beat should be restored but do not individually trigger regeneration.
